items.name: SQL Injection
items.content:
# CWE-89 SQL Injection (test fixture)

Build database queries only with parameterized statements.

- MUST pass every untrusted value as a bound parameter, never by string concatenation.
- MUST NOT build SQL text from request data.

examples.python:
# Fixture seed example (human-written)
query = "SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?"
rows = connection.execute(query, (name,)).fetchall()

items.name: OS Command Injection
items.content:
# CWE-78 OS Command Injection (test fixture)

- MUST NOT pass untrusted input to a command interpreter.
- MUST call programs with an argument list instead of a command string.

items.name: Software Supply Chain Failures
items.content:
# A03 Software Supply Chain Failures (test fixture)

- MUST pin every third-party dependency to a reviewed version and digest.
